name: Breakout

features.name: Syndicate Multipliers
features.description: Apply a multiplier to every symbol of a matching premium.

features.name: Chain Reaction Respins
features.description: Six or more matching premiums stick and respin.

review:
A prison game where every premium symbol has its own Syndicate Multiplier – when one lands, it passes its multiplier to every symbol of its type. Six or more of the same premium trigger a Chain Reaction Respin, where they stick and new ones keep adding.

Breakout Spins keep the multipliers between spins, and Clearout Spins give each premium its own life counter. The multiplier-per-symbol idea is easy to follow. High volatility, 20,000x max.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
